premiumPreview.summary: Design an accessible flashcard trainer whose study flow stays instant while every answer is durably queued and reconciled across devices.
learningOutcomes: Separate immutable card content, session state, reveal state, and scheduling revisions.
Persist idempotent answer commands before batching network transport.
Reconcile per-command outcomes without losing offline learning history.
Support pointer, touch, keyboard, reduced motion, RTL, and multilingual content.
Bound card and media caches while preserving session continuity.
premiumPreview.unlockDescription: Premium unlocks the durable command model, offline conflict worked example, service contracts, accessibility details, and measured optimizations.
